title: Sénoufo, Cebaara | Accent Network
text: Cebaara is a dialect of the larger Sénoufo language, part of the Niger-Congo language family. It is spoken primarily in northern Côte d’Ivoire, with a significant number of speakers in Mali and Burkina Faso. Sénoufo, Cebaara has a rich tradition of oral storytelling and music.
